items.title: Decide/respond to rent increase request (§ 558b BGB)
items.quote: Für Ihre Entscheidung haben Sie bis zum Ablauf des zweiten Kalendermonats nach dem Zugang dieses Schreibens Zeit.
items.computation: The letter was hand-delivered into the mailbox on 19.11.2026 in the morning ('Einwurf in Ihren Briefkasten am 19.11.2026 vormittags'), so Zugang (receipt) = 19.11.2026 (morning delivery counts as received the same day). Under § 558b Abs. 2 BGB, the tenant's consideration period for a rent-increase request runs until the end of the second calendar month following the month of receipt. Month of receipt = November 2026; +1 calendar month = December 2026; +2 calendar months = January 2027. The period therefore ends on the last day of January 2027, i.e. 31.01.2027. That date is a Sunday, so under § 193 BGB (which applies to declarations whose deadline is set by law) the deadline shifts to the next business day. 01.02.2027 (Monday) is not a public holiday in Berlin, so the deadline is 01.02.2027.

items.title: New (increased) rent takes effect, if consent is given
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie daher, einer Erhöhung der Nettokaltmiete auf 718,00 € (10,56 € je m²) mit Wirkung ab dem 01.02.2027 zuzustimmen.
items.computation: The letter states the requested rent increase is to take effect from 01.02.2027. Under § 558b Abs. 1 BGB, the higher rent becomes due from the start of the third calendar month after receipt of the request, which matches the 01.02.2027 date stated, provided the tenant consents (or is later held to consent by a successful Zustimmungsklage).

warnings: This is a private landlord's rent-increase request under § 558b BGB, not an administrative decision — it has no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and no statutory 'deemed delivery' rule; the computed deadline relies on the letter's own statement that it was hand-delivered into the mailbox on the morning of 19.11.2026, which the person should confirm.

The letter asks the tenant to sign and return an enclosed 'Zustimmungserklärung', which was not included in the text provided — the person should check that this attachment/document matches the terms described (new rent 718,00 €, effective 01.02.2027) before signing.

Not signing and returning consent by the deadline does not automatically change the rent; it only allows the landlord to sue for consent (Zustimmungsklage), so there is no automatic payment obligation from this letter alone — the person may want advice (e.g. from a Mieterverein) before deciding whether to agree, given the rent per m² (10,56 €) is below the stated comparison range up to 11,92 €.
